data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences, a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church, has raised $555M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics.

Stage-progression methodology is inapplicable; the reported post-money valuation of $10.3B implies a step-up to $17.5B, exceeding 20x total capital raised—a signal of data unreliability. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 6.6x) cannot be applied without disclosed revenue. Peer-median analysis is the sole applicable triangulation method. Across three same-sector and adjacent-stage comparables, the median valuation stands at $3.1B, with a range from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.6B to $3.6B, centered at $3.1B. Primary uncertainties stem from reliance on a single applicable method and the heterogeneity of stage positioning within the peer set. Revenue disclosure would enable public-market anchoring and narrow the range materially. The dataset warrants skepticism of any valuation materially exceeding $3.6B absent additional proprietary metrics.
